derate — style guide

Generated from the shipped sources. IBM Plex is loaded by the app's main.tsx through @fontsource, not by a stylesheet, so this page falls back to the system sans and mono stacks. Component figures are react-dom/server output of the real components; interactive ones are exercised by the browser gallery.
